rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: OMSエナジー・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: ハリバートンが売上の7%を占める顧客で、基本購入契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Halliburton accounted for 7% of its revenue and buys under a master purchase agreement

source.label: OMS Energy Technologies 20-F(2025年3月期)
source.quote: For the period from April 1, 2023 through March 31, 2024, ARAMCO and Halliburton accounted for 61% and 7% of our revenue respectively.

relations.text: 産業部門の最大級の顧客の一社にハリバートン
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among its largest industrial customers

source.label: RBC Bearings 10-K(2025年3月期)
source.quote: Our largest industrial customers include Caterpillar, Komatsu and Halliburton

companies.name: ドリリング・ツールズ・インターナショナル

relations.text: 顧客の油田サービス大手の一社にハリバートン
relations.text_en: Lists Halliburton among the diversified oilfield service customers that made up about 48% of revenue

source.label: Drilling Tools International 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our customer base is comprised of: (i) diversified OSCs, which account for approximately 48% of 2025 revenue, including but not limited to Baker Hughes Company, Halliburton Company, Phoenix Energy, and SLB

relations.text: データセンター向けに400MWのガス発電設備で戦略協業
relations.text_en: Strategic collaboration with VoltaGrid on 400 MW of modular gas power for data centers

source.label: Halliburton 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: This growth includes our strategic collaboration with VoltaGrid, for which we have secured manufacturing capacity for 400 megawatts of modular natural gas power systems for delivery in 2028 to support the development of data centers in the Eastern Hemisphere.

relations.text: 全電動の坑井や海底介入などで技術提携
relations.text_en: Technology alliance on all-electric wells, subsea interventions and more

source.label: TechnipFMC 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We have a technology alliance with Halliburton focused on the development of innovative technologies for use in all-electric wells, subsea interventions, subsea fiber optics, and carbon transportation and storage.

relations.text: 電動フラクチャリング部隊をハリバートンからリース
relations.text_en: Leases an electric fracturing crew and services from Halliburton

source.label: Vital Energy 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The Company has a lease agreement with Halliburton, which became effective during the first quarter of 2023 and extends through 2025, to provide an electric fracture stimulation crew and the related services.

companies.name: ディープ・アイソレーション

relations.text: ハリバートンと基本サービス契約を締結(2026年1月)
relations.text_en: Signed a master services agreement with Halliburton in January 2026

source.label: Deep Isolation Nuclear S-1/A(2026年4月)
source.quote: On January 28, 2026, Deep Isolation US LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Deep Isolation entered into a Master Services Agreement (the "MSA") with Halliburton Energy Services, Inc.

companies.name: テトラ・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: 海外の生産試験では競合しつつ、ハリバートンの顧客向けに下請けも行う
relations.text_en: Competes with Halliburton in international production testing but also subcontracts for its customers

source.label: TETRA Technologies 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Halliburton and Schlumberger are competitors in the international production testing markets we serve although we provide these services to their customers on a subcontract basis from time to time.

relations.text: 油田サービス部門の競合にハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among competitors of its oilfield services segment

source.label: Baker Hughes 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: OFSE competitors include SLB, Halliburton, NOV, Weatherford, and TechnipFMC.

relations.text: 主な競合にハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among its principal competitors

source.label: Weatherford 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors include SLB, Halliburton, Baker Hughes and Expro Group Holdings.

relations.text: 水圧破砕サービスでハリバートンと競合
relations.text_en: Its fracturing services compete with large integrated companies such as Halliburton

source.label: Liberty Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our hydraulic fracturing services compete with large, integrated companies such as Halliburton Company as well as other companies including Patterson-UTI Energy Inc. and ProFrac Holding Corp.

relations.text: 主な競合にハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among its major competitors

source.label: ProPetro 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include many large and small energy service companies, including Halliburton Company, Liberty Energy Inc., Patterson-UTI Energy Inc.

relations.text: 業界の世界的大手の競合としてハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among dominant global competitors

source.label: RPC 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: The oil and gas services industry includes dominant global competitors including, among others, Halliburton Company, Baker Hughes Company, and Schlumberger Ltd.

relations.text: 刺激(フラクチャリング)サービスの競合にハリバートン
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among competitors of its stimulation services

source.label: ProFrac 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our Stimulation Services competitors include Halliburton Company, Liberty Energy Inc., ProPetro Holding Corp., and Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc., among others.

companies.name: KLXエナジー・サービシズ

relations.text: 主な競合にハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among its major competitors

source.label: KLX Energy Services 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors include Schlumberger, Halliburton, Baker Hughes, Patterson-UTI Energy, Liberty Oilfield Services, RPC, ProPetro Holding Corp.

relations.text: 掘削ソリューション部門の競合にハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Says its Drilling Solutions segment competes with services from Halliburton and others

source.label: Nabors 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our Drilling Solutions segment competes with services provided by NOV Inc., Pason Systems Inc., Baker Hughes Co., Halliburton Co., SLB N.V.

relations.text: 製品分野全体の主な競合にハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among major competitors across its product lines

source.label: Innovex 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors across our product lines include Baker Hughes, Halliburton, Schlumberger, TechnipFMC, Weatherford International, Aker Solutions, and NOV.

relations.text: 仕上げ製品・サービスの競合にハリバートンを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Halliburton among competitors for its completion products and services

source.label: NCS Multistage 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our major competitors for our completion products and services include Baker Hughes Company ("Baker Hughes"), Core Laboratories Inc., DMC Global Inc., Forum Energy Technologies, Inc., Halliburton Company

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
